narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The inner shape looks like a quarter. Quarter it three times, and the third one is one square centimetre.
<bookmark mark='fold'/>Fold one corner triangle in along its line, like folding a paper flap.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It covers far more than a small piece, so a quarter is too little.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 64, 16, 4, 1; one corner triangle folds in over the inner shape; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Joining the middles of the sides keeps half the area.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Halve the area once for every new shape you draw inside.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. The outer shape is eighty square centimetres. Find the area of the second shape inside.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the phulkari; two lines appear: joining midpoints keeps half the area; halve once for each new shape; then a new outer shape of 80 square cm with an empty box for the second shape inside
